name: Views of a solid: top, front, side
definition: A single drawing of a solid hides information, so problems give you two or three flat views instead. Each view tells you the maximum height along one direction; putting them together pins down the shape, or shows that several shapes fit.
recognizeWhen: here is the view from above and from the front
which solid matches all three views
draw what you would see looking down
the picture shows the shape from the side
misconceptions: I read the top view as showing how many cubes there are rather than where they are.
I assumed only one solid could match the given views.
I mixed up the front view and the side view.
